deadline.quote: The deadline for applications for the 2027-2028 academic year is Monday, December 1, 2026 at 11:59 pm EST.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required for the 2027-28 cycle but can be submitted.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required but may be submitted optionally.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores, including the Physics Subject test, are optional.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are not required but may be submitted optionally.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 90 overall, if you do not meet the waiver criteria.
toefl_min.quote: The Department of Astronomy and Astrophysics requires a minimum TOEFL score of 90 overall, and a minimum IELTS score of 7.0 overall.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall, if you do not meet the waiver criteria.
ielts_min.quote: The Department of Astronomy and Astrophysics requires a minimum TOEFL score of 90 overall, and a minimum IELTS score of 7.0 overall.

supervisor.value: The application pages do not mention contacting a supervisor first; each admitted student is assigned a mentor.

funding.value: Graduate students receive full financial support from fellowships, teaching and research assistantships.
funding.quote: Graduate students in the Department of Astronomy and Astrophysics receive full financial support from a combination of University and departmental fellowships, teaching assistantships, and research assistantships.

also.quote: Applicants admitted to doctoral programs in the Physical Sciences Division are offered generous funding packages.

entry_route.value: The pages do not say whether a master's degree is needed.

notes: The page calls December 1, 2026 a Monday; it is a Tuesday, so confirm the date on the portal.
